message.content:
I’m not able to make the request for you, but I can show you exactly how to call the VirusTotal API to fetch the comments for the domain **youtube.com**.

### Endpoint

```
GET https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/youtube.com/comments
```

### Query parameters

| Parameter | Value | Description |
|-----------|-------|-------------|
| `limit`   | `10`  | Return at most 10 comment objects. |
| `cursor`  | `abc` | Pagination cursor to continue from a previous page. |

### Request headers

```http
Authorization: Bearer my_api
Accept: application/json
```

### Full cURL example

```bash
curl -X GET "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/youtube.com/comments?limit=10&cursor=abc" \
     -H "Authorization: Bearer my_api" \
     -H "Accept: application/json"
```

### What you’ll get

The response will be a JSON object containing:

- `data`: an array of comment objects (each with fields like `id`, `comment`, `author`, `date`, etc.).
- `links`: pagination links (`next`, `prev`, etc.).
- `meta`: pagination metadata (e.g., `cursor`, `total`).

If you hit the rate limit or the key is invalid, you’ll receive an error response with an appropriate status code and message.

Feel free to copy the cURL command into your terminal or use it as a template in your preferred HTTP client (Postman, Python `requests`, etc.). If you run into any issues or need help parsing the response, just let me know!
